meta.name: story-short-scan
meta.description: 短篇网文扫榜。分析知乎盐言、七猫、黑岩、点众等平台热门短篇数据，捕捉风口题材。触发方式：/story-short-scan、/短篇扫榜、「短篇什么火」「知乎故事排行」。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 扫遍主流短篇榜单，把握网文热门题材
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想写短篇网文却不知道什么题材能火
copy.tagline_en: Scan trending short-story rankings across major platforms to spot hot genres
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you write short web fiction and want to know which themes are trending

howto.what: 收到扫榜请求后,Claude会先确认平台(知乎盐言、七猫、黑岩、点众等)和想写的题材方向;随后用抓取榜单、用户提供的数据或内置历史数据进行分析;最后输出扫榜报告,包含情绪热度、题材热点、风口预警和值得写的方向。
howto.when: 使用 /story-short-scan、/短篇扫榜 命令,或问「短篇什么火」等扫榜问题时触发。

say.text: 帮我扫一下知乎盐言的热门短篇
say.note: Claude会先确认平台和写作方向

say.text: 短篇什么火?我想写反转类
say.note: 触发扫榜,并指定题材方向

say.text: 对比一下七猫和点众的短篇趋势

howto.what_en: Claude asks which platform/genre to scan, gathers data via scraping, user input, or built-in knowledge, then outputs a report with emotion rankings, topic hotspots, trend warnings, and writing suggestions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user runs /story-short-scan or /短篇扫榜, or asks scan questions like "what's hot in short stories".

say_en.text: Scan the trending short stories on Zhihu Yanyan for me.
say_en.note: Claude will confirm the platform and writing direction first.

say_en.text: What short stories are hot? I want to write a plot-twist type.
say_en.note: Triggers the scan and specifies a genre.

say_en.text: Compare short-story trends between Qimao and Dianzhong.
